integrity: The exact group identification is proved from the cited automorphism-stabilizer reduction plus the elementary projective-frame argument. The included symbolic computation only checks the normalized finite frame calculation and is not used as an infinite or generic proof.
scientific_limitations: The statement is restricted to the open locus where the annihilator conic pencil has four distinct base points in general position over the complex numbers; special pencils can have larger or positive-dimensional stabilizers.
title: The general syzygy-bundle hypersurface has automorphism group \(S_4\)
